name: tech.aspid.collections
description: Covariant observable collections for Unity with synchronization, filtering, and sorting. Pure C#, no engine dependency.

samples.description: Recruit, reorder and replace squad members. Track single and batch list events, stable projected card identities, and disposal through CreateSync.
Search, filter and sort an equipment catalog with chained FilteredList views. Compare automatic collection updates with explicit Update after editing item properties.
Complete FIFO work orders and return the latest completion to the queue through a LIFO undo history. Includes batch enqueue, queue and stack projections, and view cleanup.
Rank player scores by stable IDs. Replace one keyed value, preserve unaffected rows, reconnect with a case-insensitive ID, and observe dictionary projection ownership.
Track unique visitors with an observable set. Test duplicate entry and independently attach or dispose a SplitByEvents alarm while the synchronized occupancy view stays live.
